# S-03 — Execution-Boundary, Arbitration and Operational-Procedure Consolidation

## 1. Review boundary

This review records the bounded S-03 pass performed on branch `agent/corpus-industry-standards-normalisation` after S-01B and its registry-pipeline closure. It reviews current operative prose only. Amendment ledgers, historical-source declarations, explicit migration records and earlier review artefacts remain historical evidence and are not treated as current duplicate authority.

The pass applies the rule **one doctrine → one source-authoritative formulation → exact local consumers**. It does not reopen the seven surviving constitutional Schedules or commence assurance, logging, identity-evidence or external-source work.

## 5. Preserved local application rules

The following were retained because they alter application within the consumer rather than restate source doctrine:

* `OPS.VCT.AUTHORITY_CLEARANCE` records the authoriser–target–action–scope relationship and proportionate evidence selected by the verification procedure.
* the failure taxonomy determines whether conduct satisfies `OPS.FF.SECURITY_INTEGRITY`; it does not redefine ethical authority doctrine.
* the escalation playbook selects `OPS.EST` transition values and records the hold, continuation, interruption or referral outcome.
* ECONOMICS-003 supplies economic semantic fields while expressly leaving constitutional and operational outcomes to their owners.
* RELATION instruments retain consent, clarification and interaction-specific interpretation rules while referring execution and arbitration consequences.

## 6. Historical and permissible repetition

Explicit `Historical Source` declarations, migration continuations, amendment-ledger text, retired titles in provenance and S-01/S-01B review records remain unchanged. Generic mention of a “runtime schedule” remains permissible only where the text classifies an instrument type, states that a Law or domain appendix is not such an instrument, or describes source-authority failure as a class; it is not retained as a substitute for a current owner reference.

## 7. Closure assessment

The seven surviving Schedules were not expanded. The processing spine, Tendeka boundary, Annex A protection boundary, ambiguity boundary, symbolic boundary, identity/continuity boundary and capability/execution-state boundary remain constitutionally bounded. Domain doctrine remains with source-authoritative Charters; operational procedure remains with OPERATIONS. No substantive obligation was deleted without either preservation at its owner or a local application rule.

S-03 is closed. The post-pass metadata, header, terminology, section-reference, draft-boundary, profile, code-generation, symbolic, manifest, ledger and test gates pass. Two consecutive deterministic rebuilds produced generated-output-set SHA-256 `8ab513452670f556145ed714537ec1207a4e1777edbc40f44d5c53bd35eae967`.
